Sunday Jam (Open mic)

(Every 2nd Sunday of the month)

 

Join us for a relaxed afternoon of live music in the atmospheric bar of the iconic Union Chapel. Brought to you by Union Chapel Church, the session is led by our friendly and experienced in-house band.

Would you like to play?
Performance slots are free, and you can play whatever you like, solo or with friends. Slots are on a first come first served basis and really do fill up fast. To guarantee a slot let us know in advance (inc. your song selection/chord charts/audio example) by emailing us at [email protected] (subject: Jazz Jam). Requests close 48 hours before the event. For full band support, check the band repertoire below.

Please be aware that while the main bar is closed for the afternoon, wine and other beverages will be available for guests and performers on a donation basis.

Our aim is to showcase every performer in the best light possible with a top class band, sound and lighting. We aim to record every event for our YouTube channel. Please let us know if you prefer not to be filmed.

Expect some surprise entrants! Enjoy a sublime afternoon of top end jazz in one of London's most unique settings. 

Slots are interspersed with numbers from our band.
